title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Island of Love

lines.l: Palm trees sway to our song, time stands still all night long
Your laughter's the sweetest sound, in your arms I've truly found
On this island of love, free, just your heartbeat
And I see no worries, no pain, just you and me
Let the rhythm carry us away
To a place where hearts can stay
Feels like sunshine in my mind
On this island of love, love, love, we're free
Just your heartbeat and the sea
No worries, no pain, just you and me
